entries.notes: M 栏第二音节声调标记污损（T99），但 L/H/R 及 M 音节一致为拇指，释义不受影响。

entries.en: little finger; pinky
entries.notes: L 作 anular（无名指），与 H「小母」（小拇指）不合，疑 anular 为 auricular 之误；L 末「xi chay」亦近「小指」。

entries.en: index finger; forefinger
entries.notes: L 作 anuley（当为 anular，指无名指），与 H「二指」不合；H/M/R 三栏一致指食指。

ring finger; fourth finger

entries.notes: H「了戒」有疑（了/子），M liàu cay、R liàng quay 与其对音相合而义不可考，仅据 L 定为小指。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕保卫；帮助，庇护
entries.en: 〔original damaged; gloss uncertain〕 to defend; to help, to protect
entries.notes: H、R 栏空缺，M 五音无法还原汉字，仅据 L「Defender, ayudar, ampasar（疑 amparar）」拟义。

entries.en: to block; to ward off, to stop up

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕从何处来，来自哪里
entries.en: 〔original damaged; gloss uncertain〕 where (someone) came from; whence
entries.notes: H 空缺、R 仅作 Dina（义不明）；M 疑读 tùi tó-lo̍h lâi（从何处来），与 L「de donde vine」相合，然无汉字可核。

entries.en: to abandon; to let go, to give up
to lose; to lack, to omit
entries.notes: R 作 jiē，与「失」之官话对音不合，疑讹；H「失」与 M sît 一致。

entries.en: to leave (food) behind; to set aside as food
entries.notes: H 第二字「算」与 M lāu、R liù 对音不合，疑误摹或旁注；义据 L「Dejar como comida」及首字「畱（留）」。

entries.en: to cast off, to throw away; to leave to one's own will
entries.notes: M cû chúy、R gūi 均与「拋」对音不合，仅 H 义可定。

entries.en: to leave to (someone's will); to let be
entries.notes: H 有疑（任/住），M xîm 支持「任」；R xīn 对音不合。

entries.en: to stop; to let (something) end; to leave off
entries.notes: H 有疑（息/煞），M 首音 soa 近「煞」；R sē 对音不合。

entries.en: to settle the account; to enter up (leave a record of) the account
entries.notes: L 末字 asendicha 疑为 asentada（入账、结算）；H「谅算」有疑（谅/计），M/R 对音亦不合，释义存疑。

entries.zh: 罢阵，退出阵伍；撤离阵地
entries.en: to quit the ranks; to leave one's post

entries.zh: 告退，辞去官职（让与他人）
entries.en: to resign one's office; to hand one's post over to another
to let someone do as he pleases; to leave it to him
to leave out a character while writing; to omit a character
